title: Optional Cloud Rewrite Engine
objective: Add an optional, consent-gated Cloud rewrite engine mediated by a Fluent backend, with Gemini as the only active provider and DeepSeek prepared but disabled, while keeping local rewriting the unchanged default and holding no provider secrets in the Desktop.

included: Provider-agnostic domain contracts in Fluent.Rewrite: IRewriteProvider, RewriteProviderId, RewriteProviderCapabilities, provider RewriteRequest, RewriteResult, RewriteStatus, RewriteFailureReason, RewriteValidationResult
LocalRewriteProvider adapting the accepted safe local rewrite with byte-for-byte preserved local output
ICloudRewriteClient transport seam, CloudRewriteProvider routing, GeminiRewriteProvider (enabled), DeepSeekRewriteProvider (disabled, never called)
RewriteOrchestrator selecting Local by default and Cloud only under the full gate, with exact-local fallback on timeout, error, invalid, conversational, or empty result
CloudRewriteValidator composing RewriteOutputValidator with empty, length, conversational-response, and numbers/dates/URLs/paths/versions/commands/protected-term checks
New Fluent.Cloud Desktop transport project calling only the Fluent backend, holding no keys

New minimal Fluent.Backend ASP.NET project: one authenticated rate-limited validated rewrite endpoint, provider dispatcher, server Gemini provider reading model and key from server environment only, disabled server DeepSeek provider
RewriteContext (IsAuthenticated, CloudRewriteEnabled, CloudConsentGranted, Provider) and a default not-authenticated authentication-state seam without rewriting auth
First-Cloud-use explicit consent gate and minimal truthful UI states, no DeepSeek selector
Observability recording provider, response time, fallback used, and fallback cause only
Focused unit and integration tests, a Desktop-and-repo no-secret scan test, Release build, complete suite, reviews, and evidence
excluded: Ollama, llama.cpp, local model download, local models, and streaming
Any provider API key, encrypted key, embedded secret, or distributed secret configuration in the Desktop or repository
Direct Desktop-to-provider calls; the Desktop talks only to the Fluent backend
Enabling, wiring a UI for, or calling DeepSeek in this phase
A full SaaS platform, account management UI, synchronization, packaging, History, or advanced Settings
Sending any text to the Cloud when the user is only authenticated but has not enabled and consented
Live provider calls during automated verification; Whisper, audio, hotkey, capsule, Win32, target identity, password, clipboard, insertion policy, or Enter changes

acceptanceCriteria: The Release solution build passes with zero warnings and zero errors and every pre-existing test still passes.
Local rewriting is the default and its output is unchanged for the same inputs; the five baseline-manifest files keep their accepted behavior.
No provider API key, encrypted key, or embedded secret exists in the Desktop or repository, verified by an automated scan test over the tree.
Gemini is fully wired through the Fluent.Cloud backend transport; the Desktop never calls a provider directly and never receives or hard-codes the Gemini model.
DeepSeek is registered with disabled capabilities, has no UI, no key, and is never invoked in the active path; a test asserts it is never called.
RewriteOrchestrator uses Cloud only when authenticated AND Cloud enabled AND consent granted AND provider is an enabled cloud provider; all other states resolve to Local.
Any Cloud timeout, transport error, invalid or conversational response, or empty output returns the exact local text, verified by tests.
The Cloud validator preserves numbers, dates, URLs, paths, versions, commands, and protected terms and rejects empty or conversational output.
The first Cloud use requires explicit consent; being authenticated without enabling and consenting never sends text.
Observability records only provider, response time, fallback used, and fallback cause; no user content, transcript, audio, or secret is logged.

The minimal backend endpoint is authenticated, rate-limited, validated, and dispatches to a server Gemini provider that reads its key and model from server environment only, with DeepSeek disabled; its logic is unit-tested with a fake provider and no live call.
Focused tests, Release build, complete suite, code review, security review, and test review pass with no blocking finding, and the Development Judge issues ALLOW.
requiredReviews: Focused rewrite/provider architecture and fallback-safety review
Focused security and privacy review (no Desktop secrets, no user-content logging, consent gating)
risks: A Cloud provider could invent, drop, reorder, or corrupt numbers, dates, names, URLs, paths, versions, commands, or identifiers.
A conversational or refusal-style Cloud response could be inserted as if it were a rewrite.
An API key or secret could leak into the Desktop or repository.
Text could be sent to the Cloud without explicit consent or while only authenticated.
The DeepSeek provider could be accidentally wired into the active path.
Observability or error messages could leak user content.
Adding a backend introduces a network trust boundary and a non-Windows deployable that cannot be end-to-end verified without a server key.
The accepted local pipeline and baselines must be preserved while inserting the orchestrator.
rollbackPlan: Restore the direct SafeProfileRewriteService call in the dictation pipeline.
Remove the orchestrator Cloud path, Fluent.Cloud, Fluent.Backend, provider contracts, UI Cloud states, and tests.
Preserve the accepted Phase 05B database and all prior local behavior.
Rebuild and rerun the complete suite.
